name: DL-ADD MoS2/WS2 atomic-defect STM benchmark
description: Experimental STM surface images and impurity/void annotations for defect segmentation in two transition-metal dichalcogenides.
count_scope: Published evaluation cohort:70 MoS2 training +20 MoS2 test +15 WS2 transfer-test images; augmented variants excluded

sources.title: Deep learning based atomic defect detection framework for two-dimensional materials
sources.evidence: Technical Validation reports 90 MoS2 images split 70/20 and15 WS2 transfer-test images. Images use50×50 or60×60 nm fields,256×256 px, constant-current−1 V sample bias and1 nA.

sources.title: OSF DL-ADD primary project metadata
sources.evidence: Public project titled TMD-FET defect autodetection at STM images has MoS2/WS2 data folders and a project-license relationship.

sources.title: OSF dataset-associated license
sources.evidence: Associated project license is CC-By Attribution 4.0 International.

caveats: 105 counts original paper benchmark images, not all repository files, masks or augmented training examples.
Training augmentation pastes defect crops onto backgrounds and applies image transforms; generated variants are not independent measurements.
Image labels represent defect appearance, not fully resolved atomic coordinates or definitive impurity chemical identities.
Underlying materials are MoS2 and WS2;105 images are not105 unique crystal structures.

count_derivation.method: Sum of published independent image cohorts; augmentation excluded

name: 304L stainless-steel full-field DIC and infrared thermography
description: Synchronized displacement, strain, temperature and mechanical-loading data for calibrating metal-plasticity models.
count_scope: Independent test-record count not established; seven geometry designs are reported

sources.title: Digital image correlation and infrared thermography data for seven unique geometries of304L stainless steel
sources.evidence: Descriptor supplies raw/postprocessed DIC/IR and force data, specimen drawings, test matrix and metallurgy report; tests vary orientation, rate and thermal loading.

sources.title: 304L Figshare+ primary metadata
sources.evidence: Open deposit is version 1, DOI 10.25452/figshare.plus.25483534.v1, under CC0; metadata confirms repeated conditions and raw plus synchronized/registered outputs.

caveats: One rolled304L sheet lot; geometries, orientations and repeated tests are not independent material compositions.
No periodic atomic-coordinate release is established; geometric coordinates describe specimen boundaries and measurement grids.
Preserve specimen ID, rolling direction, rate, thermal loading and synchronization metadata.
Some tests have two DIC systems instead of IR; not every modality exists for every test.
Processed arrays can contain NaN for missing spatial/temporal data; MATLAB7.3 files require HDF5-compatible readers.

additional_counts.scope: Descriptor reports seven unique geometries,with conventional tensile dog-bone comparisons

name: Correlative chemical, crystallographic and magnetic iron-oxide grains
description: Individual natural iron-oxide grain chemistry, EBSD phase/orientation and magnetic-domain images registered across techniques.
count_scope: PANGAEA publication-series component count; not grain or crystal count

sources.title: Chemical,crystallographic and magnetic characterisation of individual iron-oxide grains in Hawaiian lavas
sources.evidence: Descriptor investigates 3–6 individual~3–10 µm grains from each of 11 lava flows with MFM, microprobe and SEM/EBSD; per-grain binders align techniques.

sources.title: PANGAEA primary publication series
sources.evidence: Landing page identifies23 component datasets, CC BY 3.0 Unported licensing and download routes for constituent data.

caveats: Natural-lava provenance is geological, but included evidence is grain-level material chemistry, crystallography and magnetism rather than a geospatial survey.
23 denotes component deposits; the exact count of fully characterized grains was not independently established.
EBSD orientations and microscopy are not a periodic atomic-coordinate database.
Per-site deposits and per-grain binders are complementary representations and must not be summed as independent samples.
Retain grain/site identifier, heating history and chemistry-quality flags; microprobe analyses with>2%Si can include surrounding material.

name: AISI52100 grease-lubricated rolling-contact fatigue benchmark
description: Per-trial bearing-steel fatigue lifetime, post-test damage microscopy and derived Weibull statistics under controlled lubrication.
count_scope: 21 independent trials for each of three calcium-grease grades

sources.title: Rolling contact fatigue dataset for AISI52100 bearing steel balls under calcium grease lubrication
sources.evidence: Descriptor reports 63 trials,21 per NLGI 0/00/000 grade, at 1470 rpm,5739 N peak axial load and35±3°C;1,140 optical images accompany per-trial metadata.

sources.title: Mendeley Data rolling-contact-fatigue v3
sources.evidence: Primary deposit is public, dated 25June2026, version 3, under CC BY 4.0; description identifies IP300 four-ball tests on AISI52100.

caveats: A material-response/tribology benchmark rather than a resolved-crystal structure cohort; one bearing-steel grade is investigated.
Each trial has one time-to-failure value; three lower balls in a trial share that elapsed time and are not independent fatigue tests.
Microscopy images show damage at50×magnification(5×objective)and2160×1620 px; image count differs from trial count.
Weibull curves and lifetime quantiles are derived statistical outputs, not additional measured trials.

additional_counts.scope: Damage images across63 trials and their lower balls

count_derivation.method: 21 trials in each of three grease-grade groups
